summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on debugging and deploying updates to the analytics platform. Initial issues with date pickers were resolved by reverting to an older, functional version. The team reviewed several features, including parameter selection upon initial entry (which was determined not to be a bug) and data granularity settings for time ranges (daily vs. hourly). A decision was made regarding the default display of data granularity to minimize load on the system.

Testing confirmed that unit counts now correctly display when cookies are cleared and the user accesses the site from scratch. The final action item was to merge all changes and deploy the latest version to staging for testing.
decisions: The default data granularity should remain as is (not changing it to daily) to reduce system load.
All current development work must be merged and deployed to the staging environment.
action_items: Merge all changes into the main branch.
Deploy the latest version to staging for testing.
